title: personal-kpi-weekly-checkin-isabella-choi-2026-03-13
content:
Week: 2026-03-09 — 2026-03-13
Role: Senior SRE / On-call + infra performance lead
Top-level goal / OKR alignment:
- O1: Improve 95p latency for hosted-api (text gen) by 15% for tail-heavy workloads (Q1–Q2).
- KR1: Reduce 95p P50 delta for 1k tokens by 15% (measured on canary region).
- KR2: Ship KV cache eviction change and validate no regressions in cost per token.

Progress this week (what shipped / moved forward):
- Deployed kv-cache eviction heuristic v0.3 to canary (region us-west-2).
  - Observed 8% improvement on 95p for beam-like workload during A/B (baseline vs v0.3).
  - Follow-up metric collection scheduled for next 48h to evaluate steady-state.
- Filed and iterated on PR: serving-runtime#1287 (hotfix for mem leak in batcher).
  - PR linked in artifacts; awaiting Maya's final review.
- On-call: 2 pages this week (one noisy alert related to infra autoscaler thrash).
  - Root cause: bursty small requests causing scaling oscillation; mitigation: increase cooldown and add smoothing (temporary).
- Started draft for experiment plan to test quantized kernels on A100s for common LLM layers.

Metrics / numbers to call out:
- 95p latency (canary baseline): 420ms -> v0.3: 386ms (8% improvement) — needs to hit 15% target.
- P50 unchanged (~110ms), indicating tail improvement rather than median shift.
- On-call pages: 2 this week (down from 5 last week) — good trend.
- Memory usage per pod reduced ~6% in canary after mem leak fix (+batcher patch).

Blockers / open questions:
- Need more steady-state data: current A/B window too small (only 6 hours peak). Request to extend canary by 72h.
- Kernel quantization experiment needs GPU quota increase for dedicated infra team (raise request to infra).
- Unclear perf delta on multi-tenant noisy neighbors — need to run isolation tests (ticket JIRA-INF-356).
- Maya's availability for final PR review is limited next week (out Wed-Thu) — might delay merge.

Plan for next week (concrete next actions):
- Extend canary run for kv-cache v0.3 by 72h and collect 95/99/latency histograms (OWNER: me).
- Follow up with infra to request +2 A100s for quantization experiment (OWNER: reach out to Noah).
- Add smoothing to autoscaler config as temporary fix; monitor for oscillation reduction (OWNER: me).
- Prep postmortem notes for the autoscaler thrash incident and propose longer-term mitigations (trigger: SEV3 -> engineering retro).
- Merge serving-runtime#1287 once Maya approves; schedule hotfix rollout to staging.

Quick wins / TODOs (shorthand):
- [ ] Extend canary window (done? not yet)
- [ ] Tag logs + traces with kv_cache_version for easy query
- [ ] Add canary-specific dashboard with tail histograms
- [ ] Schedule 30m sync with infra for GPU quota request
- [ ] Draft experiment README for quantized-kernel runs

Notes to self (informal):
- Remember to include cost delta analysis when presenting to product (they care about tokens/unit cost).
- When talking to product, frame wins as "reduced tail latency and cost stability" not just raw latency numbers.
- Keep an eye on P99 — if P99 moves up after wider rollout, need immediate rollback policy.

Related links / refs (quick):
- Confluence: kv-cache optimization draft: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/RUN/kv-cache-optimization
- JIRA tickets: INF-342 (kv-cache), INF-356 (isolation tests), INF-371 (autoscaler thrash)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1287

Freeform thoughts / brainstorming (messy):
- Could we try a micro-batch pooling approach for short-lived requests to reduce burstiness? Pros: less scaling churn. Cons: added latency for single-request flows. Worth A/B-ing with canary region.
- If quantized kernels show 12–18% perf gain on A100s, we should consider a rollout plan that targets cost-sensitive customer tiers first.

End-of-week reflection:
- Good traction on the kv-cache change but not yet at KR. Need longer canary and more data. On-call noise reduced which is encouraging. Keep momentum on PR reviews to avoid slipping timelines.

Last updated 2026-03-13 by Isabella Choi
